clips_detail.reference: CONCORD RETURNED TO ITS PLACE AMIDST THE TENTS
clips_detail.hypothesis: Concorde returned to its place amidst the tents.

clips_detail.reference: YOU WILL BE FRANK WITH ME I ALWAYS AM
clips_detail.hypothesis: You will be frank with me. I always am

clips_detail.reference: THIS HAS INDEED BEEN A HARASSING DAY CONTINUED THE YOUNG MAN HIS EYES FIXED UPON HIS FRIEND
clips_detail.hypothesis: This has indeed been a harassing day continued the young man his eyes fixed upon his friend

clips_detail.reference: THE COUNT HAD THROWN HIMSELF BACK ON HIS SEAT LEANING HIS SHOULDERS AGAINST THE PARTITION OF THE TENT AND REMAINED THUS HIS FACE BURIED IN HIS HANDS WITH HEAVING CHEST AND RESTLESS LIMBS
clips_detail.hypothesis: The Count had thrown himself back on his seat, leaning his shoulders against the partition of the tent and remained thus. His face buried in his hands, with heaving chest and restless limbs.

clips_detail.reference: SHE TAUGHT HER DAUGHTER THEN BY HER OWN AFFECTION FOR IT THAT LOVE FOR A COUNTRY WHERE THEY HAD BOTH BEEN HOSPITABLY RECEIVED AND WHERE A BRILLIANT FUTURE OPENED BEFORE THEM
clips_detail.hypothesis: She taught her daughter, then, by her own affection for it, that love for a country where they had both been hospitably received and where a brilliant future opened for them.

clips_detail.reference: CONGRATULATIONS WERE POURED IN UPON THE PRINCESS EVERYWHERE DURING HER JOURNEY
clips_detail.hypothesis: Congratulations, we're poured in upon the princess everywhere during her journey.

clips_detail.reference: I AM CONVINCED OF WHAT I SAY SAID THE COUNT
clips_detail.hypothesis: I am convinced of what I say, said the count.

clips_detail.reference: THUS IT IS THAT THE HONOR OF THREE IS SAVED OUR COUNTRY'S OUR MASTER'S AND OUR OWN
clips_detail.hypothesis: Thus, it is that the honor of three is saved, our country, our masters, and our own.

clips_detail.reference: FROM THE RESPECT PAID HER ON ALL SIDES SHE SEEMED LIKE A QUEEN AND FROM THE ADORATION WITH WHICH SHE WAS TREATED BY TWO OR THREE SHE APPEARED AN OBJECT OF WORSHIP THE QUEEN MOTHER GAVE THE FRENCH THE MOST AFFECTIONATE RECEPTION FRANCE WAS HER NATIVE COUNTRY AND SHE HAD SUFFERED TOO MUCH UNHAPPINESS IN ENGLAND FOR ENGLAND TO HAVE MADE HER FORGET FRANCE
clips_detail.hypothesis: From the respect paid her on all sides, she seemed like a queen, and from the adoration with which she was treated by two or three, she appeared an object of worship. The queen mother gave the French the most affectionate reception. France was her native country, and she had suffered too much unhappiness in England for England to have made her forget France.

clips_detail.reference: I CAN PERCEIVE LOVE CLEARLY ENOUGH
clips_detail.hypothesis: I can perceive love clearly enough.
